statement.zh:
你想把电视连接到位于房屋另一侧的有线电视信号接入点。你手头唯一可用于此目的的同轴电缆（T1）具有以下性质：
• 长度：$30\,\mathrm{m}$
• 特性阻抗：$75\,\Omega$
• 速度因子：$0.85$

有线电视接入点由电压源 $V_g$ 构成，其幅值为 $1\,\mathrm{V}$，源阻抗 $R_g$ 为 $75\,\Omega$，频率 $f$ 为 $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$。电视的负载阻抗 $R_L$ 也是 $75\,\Omega$。下图给出了这一连接的电路图。
statement.en:
You want to connect your television to a cable TV feed point located on the opposite side of your house. The only coaxial cable (T1) you have available for this purpose has the following properties:
• Length: $30\,\mathrm{m}$
• Characteristic impedance: $75\,\Omega$
• Velocity factor: $0.85$

The cable TV feed point consists of a voltage source $V_g$ with an amplitude of $1\,\mathrm{V}$, source impedance $R_g$ of $75\,\Omega$ and frequency $f$ of $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$. The television’s load impedance $R_L$ is also $75\,\Omega$. A circuit diagram illustrating this setup is shown below.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 如果用所给电缆将有线电视接入点连接到电视，负载处是否会发生反射？解释原因。
prompt.en: If you use the provided cable to connect the cable TV feed point to your television, will there be a reflection at the load? Explain why or why not.

text.zh: 先写原表的负载反射系数，比较的是负载阻抗和线的特性阻抗。
text.en: Begin with the crib load reflection coefficient, comparing load impedance with line characteristic impedance.

text.zh: 本题电视负载与电缆均为 75 Ω，逐项代入分子和分母。
text.en: Both the television load and cable are 75 Ω. Substitute them into numerator and denominator.

text.zh: 反射电压幅度等于入射幅度乘 ΓL，因此不存在由负载产生的反向波。
text.en: The reflected voltage amplitude is the incident amplitude times ΓL, so the load produces no backward wave.

text.zh: 结论是负载匹配、无反射；源阻抗相同也避免源端失配。
text.en: The load is matched with no reflection; the equal source impedance also avoids source mismatch.

prompt.zh: 这根同轴电缆的时间延迟是多少？
prompt.en: What is the time delay of the coaxial cable?

text.zh: 先写波速和传播时间的关系，速度因子是相对真空光速的比值。
text.en: Begin with the wave-speed and propagation-time relations; velocity factor is relative to vacuum light speed.

text.zh: 将 0.85 和 3×10⁸ m/s 代入，先得到电缆内的实际传播速度。
text.en: Substitute 0.85 and 3×10⁸ m/s to obtain the cable propagation speed first.

text.zh: 长度除以波速，米约去后结果为秒。
text.en: Divide length by speed; meters cancel, leaving seconds.

text.zh: 利用 1 ns=10⁻⁹ s 转换单位；这是单程时间，不再乘 2。
text.en: Convert using 1 ns=10⁻⁹ s. This is one-way time, so do not multiply by two.

prompt.zh: 信号在这根同轴电缆上的波长是多少
prompt.en: What is the wavelength of the signal on the coaxial cable

text.zh: 先写原表的波长关系，使用电缆内部波速。
text.en: Begin with the crib wavelength relation, using the cable wave speed.

text.zh: 把频率由 MHz 换成 Hz，并写出上问得到的波速。
text.en: Convert MHz to Hz and state the previously determined speed.

text.zh: 将数值及单位代入波长公式。
text.en: Substitute numerical values and units into the wavelength equation.

text.zh: 化简得到电缆内波长，而非真空中的 1.20 m。
text.en: Simplify to the cable wavelength, rather than the vacuum wavelength of 1.20 m.

prompt.zh: 假设可将电缆视为低损耗线，且单位长度电阻为 $r=1\,\Omega/\mathrm{m}$，计算负载处入射电压波的幅值。
prompt.en: Assuming that the cable can be considered low-loss and has a per-length resistance of $r=1\,\Omega/\mathrm{m}$, calculate the amplitude of the incident voltage wave at the load.

text.zh: 先写原表的低损耗衰减式与行波包络；本题使用可忽略并联漏电导的模型。
text.en: Begin with the crib low-loss attenuation and traveling-wave envelope, using the model with negligible shunt conductance.

text.zh: 代入每单位长度电阻和特性阻抗，求出 α。
text.en: Substitute resistance per length and characteristic impedance to calculate α.

text.zh: 负载入射波的起始幅度不是源电压 1 V，必须先做源端分压。
text.en: The launched amplitude is not the 1 V source voltage; apply the source divider first.

text.zh: 传播到 30 m，衰减指数 αL 是无量纲的 0.2。
text.en: At 30 m, the attenuation exponent αL is dimensionless and equals 0.2.

text.zh: 求指数值得到负载处的入射电压幅度；ΓL=0，所以没有额外反射项。
text.en: Evaluate the exponential to obtain the incident load amplitude. Since ΓL=0, there is no additional reflected term.

prompt.zh: 如果同轴电缆的特性阻抗改为 $50\Omega$，为保证从源到负载的最大功率传输，所需电缆的最小长度 $(L>0)$ 是多少？
prompt.en: If the coaxial cable’s characteristic impedance were instead $50\Omega$, what is the minimum length of cable $(L>0)$ needed to be to ensure maximum power transfer from the source to the load?

text.zh: 最大功率传输要求源看到的输入阻抗与 75 Ω 源电阻匹配；按原题采用无损匹配近似。
text.en: Maximum power transfer requires the input seen by the source to match its 75 Ω resistance. Use the source’s lossless matching approximation.

text.zh: 原表的半波线性质会将负载原样重复到输入端，不论中间电缆是否为 50 Ω。
text.en: The crib half-wave property repeats the load at the input even with a 50 Ω cable in between.

text.zh: 核对最短正长度：代入通用输入阻抗并令 Zin=ZL，因 Z₀≠ZL，只能使 tan(βL)=0。
text.en: Check the shortest positive length: setting Zin=ZL in the general equation with Z₀≠ZL requires tan(βL)=0.

text.zh: 沿用同一速度因子与频率，波长仍为 1.02 m，n 取最小正整数 1。
text.en: The unchanged velocity factor and frequency give λ=1.02 m. Choose the smallest positive integer n=1.

text.zh: 这是重复阻抗的半波长度，不是把 75 Ω 变换成另一电阻的四分之一波长。
text.en: This is the half-wave impedance-repeat length.

concept.zh: 本题把传输线匹配、传播速度和低损耗衰减放在同一条有线电视连接中考查。
concept.en: This problem connects impedance matching, propagation speed and low-loss attenuation in a cable-TV link.

known.zh: 电缆长 $30\,\mathrm m$，速度因子为 $0.85$，频率为 $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$；初始情况下源、线和负载均为 $75\,\Omega$。衰减小问另给出单位长度电阻。
known.en: The cable is $30\,\mathrm m$ long, with velocity factor $0.85$ and frequency $250\,\mathrm{MHz}$. Initially the source, line and load are all $75\,\Omega$; the attenuation part also supplies the resistance per unit length.

goal.zh: 判断反射，求延迟、波长和到达负载的入射电压，再研究换用另一种电缆后的最短匹配长度。
goal.en: Check reflection, find delay, wavelength and the incident voltage at the load, then find the shortest matching length for a different cable.

approach.zh: 先比较负载与特性阻抗，再把速度因子换成波速。求电压幅值时分别考虑源端分压和沿线衰减；最后利用输入阻抗随电长度重复的性质。
approach.en: Start by comparing load and line impedances, then convert velocity factor to speed. Separate the launch voltage divider from propagation loss, and use the periodicity of input impedance for the final part.

title.zh: 传输线与超导量子比特

statement.zh:
在超导量子计算机中，沿传输线发送（微波）电压脉冲来对量子比特进行操作。考虑一根具有以下参数的传输线：
• 单位长度电感：$l=400\,\mathrm{nH/m}$
• 单位长度电容：$c=160\,\mathrm{pF/m}$
• 传输时间（延迟）：$T_d=10\,\mathrm{ns}$
在 $t=0$ 时，电压源沿传输线向负载发送一个幅值为 $3\,\mathrm{V}$、持续时间为 $1\,\mathrm{ns}$ 的单个直流脉冲。由于电路损坏，源阻抗和负载阻抗从原设计值增大为 $R_g=100\,\Omega$ 和 $R_L=200\,\Omega$，如下方电路图所示。
statement.en:
In superconducting quantum computers, (microwave) voltage pulses are sent down transmission lines to perform operations on qubits. Consider one such transmission line with the following parameters:
• Per-length inductance: $l=400\,\mathrm{nH/m}$
• Per-length capacitance: $c=160\,\mathrm{pF/m}$
• Transit time (delay): $T_d=10\,\mathrm{ns}$
At time $t=0$, the voltage source sends a single DC pulse with amplitude $3\,\mathrm{V}$ and duration $1\,\mathrm{ns}$ down the transmission line toward the load. Due to damage to the circuit, the values of the source impedance and load impedance have increased from their originally designed values to $R_g=100\,\Omega$ and $R_L=200\,\Omega$, as shown in the circuit schematic below.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线的特性阻抗。
prompt.en: Calculate the characteristic impedance of the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写无损传输线特性阻抗原式。l、c 都是每单位长度参数。
text.en: Begin with the lossless characteristic-impedance equation; l and c are both per-length parameters.

text.zh: 先把 nH 与 pF 换成 H 与 F，两个前缀不能直接相消。
text.en: Convert nH and pF to H and F before forming their ratio.

text.zh: 计算根号内的比值，单位为 Ω²。
text.en: Evaluate the ratio under the square root, in Ω².

text.zh: 取正平方根，因为这里特性阻抗为正实数。
text.en: Take the positive square root for this positive real characteristic impedance.

prompt.zh: 进入传输线的初始电压脉冲 $V_1^+$ 的幅值是多少？
prompt.en: What is the initial amplitude of the voltage pulse $V_1^+$ that makes it into the transmission line?

text.zh: 原始分压公式给出尚未收到负载反射时进入线路的第一行波。
text.en: The launch-divider equation gives the first traveling wave before any load reflection returns.

text.zh: 本题源脉冲为 3 V，损坏后的源电阻为 100 Ω，线路仍为 50 Ω。
text.en: The source pulse is 3 V, the damaged source resistance is 100 Ω and the line remains 50 Ω.

text.zh: 先求分压比 50/150=1/3，再乘源幅度；脉冲宽度仍是 1 ns。
text.en: Evaluate 50/150=1/3 and multiply by source amplitude; pulse width remains 1 ns.

text.zh: 因此最初入射到线路的电压是 1 V，而非整个源脉冲的 3 V。
text.en: The initially launched voltage is therefore 1 V.

parts.label: c

prompt.zh: 画出 $0\le t<4T$ 内脉冲电压幅值的反弹图。必须标注行波电压幅值，以及在负载和源端测得的幅值。不必计算 $t=4T_d$ 时源端的总电压。
prompt.en: Sketch a bounce diagram for the voltage amplitude of the pulse for time $0\le t<4T$. Be sure to label both traveling voltage amplitudes and the amplitudes that would be measured at the load and the source. You do not need to calculate the total voltage at the source for $t=4T_d$.

text.zh: 先写端点反射公式以及到达波与反射波相加得到测量电压的关系。
text.en: Begin with endpoint reflection and the relation between measured voltage, arriving wave and its immediate reflection.

text.zh: 分别把负载和源阻抗代入，得到两个正的反射系数。
text.en: Substitute the load and source resistances separately to obtain both positive reflection coefficients.

text.zh: 初始脉冲在 0 时刻从源出发，于 Tᵈ=10 ns 到达负载；负载产生第一反向波。
text.en: The initial pulse leaves the source at zero and reaches the load at Tᵈ=10 ns, producing the first backward wave.

text.zh: 逐项计算第一次负载反射及负载实际电压；此处反射系数乘的是入射的 V₁⁺。
text.en: Calculate the first load reflection and actual load voltage. The reflection coefficient multiplies incident V₁⁺.

text.zh: 20 ns 时反向波回到源，源反射生成 V₂⁺；源端测到的是 V₁⁻+V₂⁺。
text.en: At 20 ns the return reaches the source and generates V₂⁺; measured source voltage is V₁⁻+V₂⁺.

text.zh: 30 ns 时第二次正向脉冲到达负载，继续乘 ΓL，负载电压仍是到达波与反射波之和。
text.en: At 30 ns the second forward pulse reaches the load. Multiply by ΓL again and add arrival plus reflection.

text.zh: 在反弹图上按 0、10、20、30、40 ns 标时刻。所有波宽均为 1 ns，彼此不重叠，不能像永久阶跃那样累加旧脉冲。
text.en: Label the diagram at 0, 10, 20, 30 and 40 ns. All pulses last 1 ns and do not overlap, so do not accumulate old pulses as for a permanent step.

steps.math: \begin{gathered}V_1^-=0.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^+=0.20\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=0.12\,\mathrm V\\V_L(10\,\mathrm{ns})=1.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_{\mathrm{in}}(20\,\mathrm{ns})=0.80\,\mathrm V,\quad V_L(30\,\mathrm{ns})=0.32\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

parts.answer: \begin{gathered}V_1^-=0.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^+=0.20\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=0.12\,\mathrm V\\V_L(10\,\mathrm{ns})=1.60\,\mathrm V,\quad V_{\mathrm{in}}(20\,\mathrm{ns})=0.80\,\mathrm V,\quad V_L(30\,\mathrm{ns})=0.32\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

figureCaption.zh: 1 ns 有限脉冲的反弹图：标出各行波及源、负载处的测量电压。
figureCaption.en: Bounce diagram for a finite 1 ns pulse, labeling traveling waves and measured source/load voltages.

prompt.zh: 经过无限多次反弹后 $(t\to\infty)$，传输线上的电压是多少？
prompt.en: What will be the voltage on the transmission line after an infinite number of bounces $(t\to\infty)$?

text.zh: 先写每一轮反弹的递推式；相继正向波相差一整次负载反射和源反射。
text.en: Begin with the bounce recurrence: successive forward waves differ by one load and one source reflection.

text.zh: 将上一问两系数相乘，得到小于 1 的往返倍率。
text.en: Multiply the preceding coefficients to obtain the round-trip factor, smaller than one.

text.zh: 题目只发出一个 1 ns 脉冲，源随后回到零；后续有限宽脉冲的幅度逐轮趋于零。
text.en: Only one 1 ns pulse is emitted, after which the source returns to zero; subsequent finite-width pulse amplitudes decay to zero.

text.zh: 因此稳态没有持续激励。端点电阻吸收脉冲能量，不能套用持续 DC 源的分压值。
text.en: There is no sustained excitation. The termination resistors absorb the pulse energy, so a permanent-DC divider value does not apply.

concept.zh: 本题考查有限宽度脉冲在失配传输线上的发射、反射与反弹图。
concept.en: This problem follows the launch and repeated reflections of a finite-duration pulse on a mismatched line.

known.en: The line has $l=400\,\mathrm{nH/m}$, $c=160\,\mathrm{pF/m}$ and $T_d=10\,\mathrm{ns}$. A $3\,\mathrm V$, $1\,\mathrm{ns}$ source pulse drives $R_g=100\,\Omega$ and $R_L=200\,\Omega$.

goal.zh: 求特性阻抗和初始入射脉冲，标清各次反射与端点测得的电压，并判断长时间后的状态。
goal.en: Find the characteristic impedance and initial pulse, label reflected waves and measured endpoint voltages, and determine the long-time behavior.

approach.zh: 先由分布参数求特性阻抗，再求源端分压与两端反射系数。反弹图中要区分行波幅值和端点总电压，并记住源脉冲会结束。
approach.en: Find line impedance from its distributed parameters, then the launch divider and both reflection coefficients. Distinguish traveling-wave amplitudes from total endpoint voltage, and remember that the source pulse ends.

topic.zh: 输入阻抗 · 电压相量

statement.zh: 下图电路中的传输线具有特性阻抗 $Z_0=50\Omega$，长度为 $L=\frac{\lambda}{4}$。正弦源电压的幅值为 $V_g=10\,\mathrm{V}$，其波长为 $\lambda=20\,\mathrm{m}$，频率为 $f=100\,\mathrm{kHz}$。
statement.en: The transmission line in the circuit below has a characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$ and length $L=\frac{\lambda}{4}$. The amplitude of the sinusoidal source voltage is $V_g=10\,\mathrm{V}$, its wavelength is $\lambda=20\,\mathrm{m}$ and its frequency is $f=100\,\mathrm{kHz}$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.zh: 输入阻抗的四分之一波长性质

text.zh: 先写原表的四分之一波长阻抗变换性质。
text.en: Begin with the crib quarter-wave impedance transformation.

text.zh: 将本题 Z₀=50 Ω、负载 125 Ω 代入，平方的阻抗单位要保留。
text.en: Substitute Z₀=50 Ω and load 125 Ω, retaining units in the squared impedance.

text.zh: 由 λ/4 的变换性质，输入为实数；与 50 Ω 源并不匹配。
text.en: The quarter-wave property gives a real input, which does not match the 50 Ω source.

prompt.zh: 写出传输线上总电压波 $\widetilde V(z)$ 的相量。
prompt.en: Write down the phasor for the total voltage wave $\widetilde V(z)$ on the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写总行波相量原式。明确本页取输入端 z=0、负载端 z=L，源相位为零。
text.en: Begin with the total traveling-wave phasor. Set z=0 at the input, z=L at the load and zero source phase.

text.zh: 由波长求 β 与线长，再求往返传播相位。
text.en: Use the wavelength to compute β and length, then the round-trip phase.

text.zh: 先计算负载参考面的反射系数。
text.en: First calculate the reflection coefficient at the load reference plane.

text.zh: 移至输入参考面必须乘往返相位；因此输入面的反向系数是负的。
text.en: Moving to the input plane requires the round-trip phase, making the backward coefficient negative there.

text.zh: 写源端电压边界。Rg=Z₀ 时反向项抵消，只剩 2V⁺，由此确定正向幅度。
text.en: Write the source voltage boundary. Since Rg=Z₀, the backward terms cancel, leaving 2V⁺ and fixing the forward amplitude.

text.zh: 代入 Vg=10 V，并乘输入反射系数求反向幅度。
text.en: Substitute Vg=10 V and multiply by the input reflection coefficient for the backward amplitude.

text.zh: 核对输入端分压：相量之和应为 10×20/(50+20)。这也检验反向项的符号。
text.en: Check input voltage division: the coefficient sum must equal 10×20/(50+20), verifying the backward sign.

text.zh: 将 β、正向与反向系数代回总行波相量。
text.en: Substitute β and both amplitudes into the traveling-wave phasor.

note.zh: 官方解写成 5e⁻ʲᵝᶻ+2.145eʲᵝᶻ，却未声明原点。对本页明确的“输入端 z=0、源相位 0”约定，反向项必须为负，否则不满足输入分压。若以负载为原点，两项还需统一的 −j 相位。
note.en: The official solution prints 5e⁻ʲᵝᶻ+2.145eʲᵝᶻ without fixing its origin. For the input-origin, zero-source-phase convention here, the backward term must be negative to satisfy the source divider. With a load origin both coefficients also carry a common −j phase.

prompt.zh: 将 $\widetilde V(z)$ 的表达式转换为时域形式 $v(z,t)$。
prompt.en: Convert your expression for $\widetilde V(z)$ to the time domain $v(z,t)$.

text.zh: 先写相量到瞬时值的定义，采用与前问相同的 eʲωt 约定。
text.en: Begin with the phasor-to-time definition using the same eʲωt convention as above.

text.zh: 将 100 kHz 转为 Hz，再计算角频率。
text.en: Convert 100 kHz to Hz and calculate angular frequency.

text.zh: 把上一问两个行波全部代入，并把时间因子分别乘进去。
text.en: Substitute both preceding waves and distribute the time factor.

text.zh: 逐项使用 Re(eʲθ)=cosθ；第二项的负实幅度必须保留。
text.en: Apply Re(eʲθ)=cosθ term by term, retaining the negative real amplitude of the second wave.

prompt.zh: 要向负载传输最大功率，需要找到一根长度相同 $(L=\lambda/4)$、但特性阻抗不同的传输线。新传输线的特性阻抗应是多少？
prompt.en: In order to deliver maximum power to the load, you would need to find a transmission line with the same length $(L=\lambda/4)$, but with a different characteristic impedance. What would the characteristic impedance of this new transmission line need to be?

text.zh: 先写最大功率传输的实阻抗匹配条件，以及原表四分之一波长变换式。
text.en: Begin with the resistive maximum-power matching condition and the crib quarter-wave relation.

text.zh: 保持线长 λ/4，待选的是变换线的特性阻抗 Z₀T。把源和负载代入。
text.en: Keep the length λ/4 and solve for transformer characteristic impedance Z₀T. Substitute source and load values.

text.zh: 两边乘 125 Ω，再取正平方根。
text.en: Multiply by 125 Ω and take the positive square root.

text.zh: 所得特性阻抗使源看到 50 Ω 的实输入阻抗。
text.en: The resulting characteristic impedance presents a real 50 Ω input to the source.

prompt.zh: 虽然第 (d) 问所选传输线在稳态下向负载传输最大功率，但传输线负载处仍会发生反射。为什么最大功率传输与传输线上的反射可以同时存在？
prompt.en: Even though the transmission line you chose in part (d) delivers maximum power to the load in steady state, reflections will still occur on the transmission line at the load. How can there be maximum power transfer, but also reflections on the transmission line?

text.zh: 先写负载局部反射系数，再写整个网络向源呈现的输入阻抗；两者的参考位置不同。
text.en: Begin with the local load reflection coefficient and the input impedance of the whole network; they describe different reference planes.

text.zh: 将上一问选出的 Z₀T 代入输入阻抗，明确验证源端匹配。
text.en: Substitute the chosen Z₀T and explicitly verify the source input match.

text.zh: 同一个变换线在负载处仍与 125 Ω 不相等，所以局部反射系数非零。
text.en: At the load the transformer impedance still differs from 125 Ω, so the local reflection coefficient remains nonzero.

text.zh: 无损线上的正反波共同构成匹配的输入电压电流比。接受的净功率沿线守恒，内部反向波并不等于没有功率送入负载。
text.en: Forward and backward waves jointly produce the matched input V/I ratio. Net accepted power is conserved along the lossless line despite the internal backward wave.

text.zh: 因此最大功率传输与负载存在反射可以同时成立。
text.en: Maximum power transfer can therefore coexist with load reflections.

answerText.zh: 输入端整体匹配与内部反射可以同时存在。
answerText.en: Overall input matching can coexist with internal reflections.

concept.zh: 本题考查四分之一波长阻抗变换，以及相量、时域波形与功率匹配之间的联系。
concept.en: This problem links quarter-wave impedance transformation, phasors, time-domain waves and power matching.

known.zh: 原电路中 $Z_0=50\,\Omega$、$L=\lambda/4$、$R_g=50\,\Omega$、$R_L=125\,\Omega$；源幅值为 $10\,\mathrm V$，并给出了波长与频率。
known.en: The original circuit has $Z_0=50\,\Omega$, $L=\lambda/4$, $R_g=50\,\Omega$ and $R_L=125\,\Omega$. The source amplitude is $10\,\mathrm V$, and wavelength and frequency are supplied.

goal.zh: 求输入阻抗、总电压的相量和时域表达式，选择匹配用电缆，并解释匹配时为何仍可存在局部反射。
goal.en: Find input impedance and total voltage in phasor and time-domain form, choose a matching line, and explain why local reflections can remain.

approach.zh: 先用四分之一波长的特殊性质看清输入端负载，再由源端边界条件确定行波。将端口是否匹配与负载处是否反射分开讨论。
approach.en: Use the quarter-wave property to identify the impedance seen by the source, then determine the waves from the source boundary condition. Treat port matching and reflection at the load as separate questions.

statement.zh: 要求使用一段开路传输线支节，将负载阻抗 $Z_L=150+j75\,\Omega$ 匹配到特性阻抗为 $Z_0=75\,\Omega$ 的馈线。单支节匹配电路如下图所示。试卷末尾附有 Smith 图，供你记录答案，并将提供直尺。
statement.en: You have been asked to match the load impedance $Z_L=150+j75\,\Omega$ to a feedline with characteristic impedance $Z_0=75\,\Omega$ by using an open-circuited transmission line stub. A diagram of the single-stub matching circuit is shown below. A Smith chart is attached to the back of your exam for recording your answers. A ruler will also be provided.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.zh: 阻抗归一化与 Smith 图

prompt.zh: 计算归一化负载阻抗，并在 Smith 图上标出。
prompt.en: Calculate the normalized load impedance and plot it on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化定义。这里 z 为无量纲负载阻抗，参考阻抗取该题馈线的 Z₀。
text.en: Begin with normalization. The load impedance z is dimensionless and referenced to the feedline Z₀.

text.zh: 把复负载的实部和虚部分别除以 Z₀，保留电抗的正号。
text.en: Divide the real and imaginary parts by Z₀ separately, preserving the positive reactance.

text.zh: 在 Smith 阻抗图中找 r=Re(zL) 圆与 x=Im(zL)>0 弧的交点；也可用反射系数验证坐标。
text.en: On the impedance chart intersect the r=Re(zL) circle with the positive-x reactance arc; verify the plotted coordinate with the reflection coefficient.

text.zh: 将已归一化的复数代入，得到该点的 Γ 平面坐标；它位于上半平面。
text.en: Substitute the normalized complex impedance to obtain its Γ-plane coordinate, in the upper half-plane.

prompt.zh: 在 Smith 图上标出归一化负载导纳，并展示如何从已标出的归一化负载阻抗确定它。写出从 Smith 图上读到的归一化负载导纳。
prompt.en: Plot the normalized load admittance on the Smith chart and show how you determined it from the plotted normalized load impedance. Write down the normalized load admittance you found from the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化导纳定义，再代入 Y=1/Z，说明为什么结果是 1/zL。
text.en: Begin with normalized admittance and substitute Y=1/Z to show why it equals 1/zL.

text.zh: 复数取倒数要乘共轭数；分母变成实部平方加虚部平方。
text.en: Take the complex reciprocal by multiplying by the conjugate; the denominator becomes the sum of squared components.

text.zh: 在同一阻抗网格上读取导纳时，表示坐标应关于图心反转，即旋转 180°。这不是让实际负载的反射改变符号。
text.en: Reading admittance on the same impedance grid requires reversing the displayed point through the center, a 180° rotation; the actual load reflection does not change sign.

text.zh: 因此沿同一个等模圆转到对径点，再读出电导与电纳；代数倒数与图上结果一致。
text.en: Move to the diametrically opposite point on the same magnitude circle and read conductance and susceptance; the algebraic reciprocal verifies the chart.

prompt.zh: 计算开路支节应放置在距负载多远的位置 $d_1$（用波长表示），并给出该处传输线的输入导纳 $y_d$。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一数值所需的全部过程。
prompt.en: Calculate the distance $d_1$ (in terms of wavelength) from the load where the open-circuited stub should be placed, and give the input admittance $y_d$ of the transmission line at that point. Show all necessary work on the Smith chart for how you determined this value.

text.zh: 先从原表输入阻抗式取倒数并归一化，得到向源移动距离 d 后的输入导纳。
text.en: Begin by taking the reciprocal of the crib input-impedance equation and normalizing to obtain admittance a distance d toward the source.

text.zh: 把负载导纳分成 g+jb，将分母写成实部 1−bt 与虚部 gt。
text.en: Write load admittance as g+jb and express the denominator with real part 1−bt and imaginary part gt.

text.zh: 乘分母共轭数，单独取实部。匹配实部要求实际输入电导等于 Y₀，即归一化实部等于 1。
text.en: Multiply by the denominator conjugate and take the real part. Matching conductance to Y₀ requires normalized real part one.

text.zh: 展开分母并把右边移到左边，得到可逐项代入的二次方程。
text.en: Expand the denominator and collect terms to obtain the quadratic for substitution.

text.zh: 把本题的 g、b 代入并求根；两个根对应 Smith 图与 g=1 圆的两个交点。
text.en: Substitute this load’s g and b and solve. The two roots correspond to the intersections with the g=1 circle on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 列出两个 t 值，再由 t=tan(2πd/λ) 选 0≤d<λ/2 的分支。
text.en: List both t values, then choose branches satisfying 0≤d<λ/2 using t=tan(2πd/λ).

text.zh: 反正切的负值要加 π 后再除以 2π；距离按 λ/2 周期重复。图上对应从负载向源顺时针旋转。
text.en: For a negative arctangent add π before dividing by 2π. Distances repeat modulo λ/2; on the chart rotate clockwise toward the source.

text.zh: 把两个距离对应的 t 代回输入导纳式，验证实部确为 1，并保留待抵消的虚部。
text.en: Substitute each t back into the admittance formula to verify real part one and retain the susceptance to be cancelled.

text.zh: 选第一组非负距离作为本页主答案；另一分支仍是有效匹配方案。
text.en: Choose the first nonnegative distance as the primary solution; the other branch is also valid.

note.zh: 另一有效分支为 d=0.375λ、yd=1−j。所有距离按 λ/2 周期重复。
note.en: The other branch is d=0.375λ with yd=1−j. Distances repeat modulo λ/2.

figureCaption.zh: 阻抗与导纳在同一 Smith 网格上的对径点、g=1 的两个交点及第一组匹配旋转。
figureCaption.en: Diametrically opposite impedance/admittance chart points, both g=1 intersections, and the first matching rotation.

prompt.zh: 计算匹配源所需的支节长度 $l_1$（用波长表示），并给出该长度开路支节的输入导纳 $y_s$。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一数值所需的全部过程。
prompt.en: Calculate the length $l_1$ (in terms of wavelength) of the stub needed to match the source, and give the input admittance $y_s$ of the open-circuited stub of that length. Show all necessary work on the Smith chart for how you determined this value.

text.zh: 先写原表开路传输线阻抗，再取倒数并用 Y₀=1/Z₀ 归一化。
text.en: Begin with the crib open-line impedance, then invert and normalize with Y₀=1/Z₀.

text.zh: 支节并联时导纳相加，目标是总归一化导纳为 1。若主线为 1+jB，支节必须为 −jB。
text.en: Parallel admittances add and the target total is one. If the main line is 1+jB, the stub must supply −jB.

text.zh: 代入 c) 选中分支的电纳，列出需要满足的正切方程。
text.en: Insert the susceptance of the selected branch from c) and write the tangent equation.

text.zh: 选最小非负的开路支节长度；正切为负时使用第二象限的电长度。
text.en: Choose the smallest nonnegative open-stub length; a negative tangent requires a second-quadrant electrical length.

text.zh: 核对虚部恰好抵消；若改用另一主线交点，必须同时改用配套的支节长度。
text.en: Check exact susceptance cancellation. Choosing the other main-line intersection also requires its corresponding stub length.

text.zh: 本页所选分支的开路支节参数如下。
text.en: The open-stub parameters for the selected branch are:

concept.zh: 本题考查 Smith 图上的阻抗与导纳转换，以及并联开路支节匹配。
concept.en: This problem uses Smith-chart impedance/admittance conversion and a parallel open-circuit matching stub.

known.zh: 负载为 $Z_L=(150+j75)\,\Omega$，馈线与支节的特性阻抗为 $75\,\Omega$，支节终端开路。
known.en: The load is $Z_L=(150+j75)\,\Omega$, the lines have characteristic impedance $75\,\Omega$, and the stub is open-circuited.

goal.zh: 依次找出归一化负载阻抗、导纳、支节接入距离和支节长度，并在图上说明过程。
goal.en: Locate the normalized load impedance and admittance, then find the stub position and length with the construction shown on the chart.

approach.zh: 并联结构用导纳相加最直接。先把负载转为导纳，沿等反射系数圆转到实部匹配的位置，再让开路支节补偿剩余的虚部。
approach.en: Admittances add directly in a parallel network. Convert the load to admittance, rotate along its constant-reflection circle until the real part matches, then cancel the remaining imaginary part with the open stub.
